name: AdvancedPaste
description: Sign-off suite for PowerToys AdvancedPaste. Core value = clipboard FORMAT TRANSFORMS (paste as plain text / markdown / json), driven at the behavioral layer against REAL product code (TransformHelpers/JsonHelper/MarkdownHelper/PasteFormats), plus a live UIA smoke of the real Advanced Paste window (summoned via its named-pipe ShowUI message, no global hotkey).

checks.description: Paste-as-plain-text returns the plain text payload and strips HTML rich formatting (TransformHelpers.ToPlainTextAsync -> GetTextOrEmptyAsync).
Paste-as-markdown converts clipboard HTML into Markdown (heading + bold) (MarkdownHelper.ToMarkdownAsync).
Paste-as-json converts CSV clipboard text into a JSON array-of-arrays (JsonHelper.ToJsonFromXmlOrCsvAsync).
Paste-as-json converts XML clipboard text into JSON (SerializeXmlNode path).
Paste-as-json returns already-valid JSON unchanged (IsJson short-circuit).
Reliability contract: Json transform returns empty string (never throws) when the clipboard has no text (PR #48124 guardrail).
The REAL Advanced Paste window (summoned via named-pipe ShowUI, no global hotkey) exposes the three core paste-format actions and gates the AI prompt box when AI is not configured.
PasteFormats metadata is the source of truth for AI gating: PlainText/Markdown/Json are core & non-AI; KernelQuery/CustomTextTransformation require AI.
Clipboard hex-color detection for history-item preview (ClipboardItemHelper.IsRgbHexColor).
